rationale: The reproduced Appendix Table 1 percentiles (outputs/apptab1_importgrowth.csv) give weighted percentiles of ten-year-equivalent d_tradeusch_pw (in kUSD/worker): for 1990 (1990-2000) p25=0.6231, p50=0.8887, p75=1.3155; for 2000 (2000-2007) p25=1.5994, p50=2.1129, p75=3.1138. Converting to 2007 US$ per worker: median $889/$2113, p25 $623/$1599, p75 $1316/$3114. Each is within ~1% of the paper values ($890/$2110 median, $620/$1600 p25, $1320/$3110 p75), well inside the 5% match band. The 75-vs-25 spread is roughly twice the median in both periods (1.32/0.62 vs 0.89; 3.11/1.60 vs 2.11), consistent with the claim. Step 7 (replication_log.json) notes an EXACT match to the authors' shipped Stata 'summ [aw], detail' in czone_analysis_ipw_final.log; no fixes were applied (code_modified=false), and fix_severity shows no critical fix in this path.
